notes.title: 1.1.3 Updates
notes.notes:
- Fixed a problem when Sumireko uses the barrier ability.
- Other minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: "Masterpieces" Update! (Version 1.1.2)
notes.notes:
・New mode "Masterpieces" added! Defeat the best spell card of each character!
・Some fairy units have new or updated abilities. Let us help you with your strategy!

notes.title: 1.0.3 Updates
notes.notes: -You can now remove a unit from a party.

notes.title: 1.0.2 Updates
notes.notes:
-Fixed issues in the abilities of some units.
-Fixed issues in the spell practice.

notes.title: 1.0.1 Updates
notes.notes:
-Fixed an issue that the sound effects did not sound.
-Fixed an issue that the random seed did not change on retry.
-Fixed an issue that the diagonal movement speed was faster than the normal movement speed.
